name: Hisada Shuusuke
source:
The main character.
He is an ordinary salaryman who works for a company.
He unexpectedly meets Sakina, whom he knew in elementary school, on a marriage activity app.
After dating for a year, they ended up getting married.
He is not familiar with the subculture and does not know about Sakina's past or the live-streaming she is currently doing.

The main character.
